description: Beautifully updated 1-Bed and 1-Bath home with stunning views of the water and Angel Island. This newly renovated home strikes a perfect balance of modern upgrades, while preserving the classic architecture and charm of Sausalito's coveted Old Town neighborhood.  Private deeded view deck.  In-unit washer and dryer.  Rare combination of warmth, walkability, and effortless access in one of Marin's most sought-after enclaves.  Whether used as a refined pied--terre, a full-time retreat, or investment in a tightly held neighborhood, the home offers an ideal blend of simplicity and sophistication in one of the best locations Sausalito has to offer. From your front door, downtown Sausalito becomes an extension of everyday life. Stroll to acclaimed waterfront restaurants, charming cafs, boutiques, galleries, and the vibrant energy of the harbor, all just moments away.  When the City calls, quick access to San Francisco makes commuting or city escapes remarkably seamlessoffering buyers the absolute best of both worlds: a quiet, sun-filled coastal retreat with world-class urban convenience always within reach.
